upstream.commit_signature: unsigned; identity is pin matching, not signer authentication

minimality_scope: Import-irredundant generating roots within the exact requested union; not a claim that no broader umbrella module could serve as a single larger root.

identity_manifest.algorithm: SHA256(UTF-8(JSON array sorted by module, each containing relative_path/git_blob_sha1/sha256/bytes, sort_keys=true, separators=(comma,colon)) plus one LF)

official_toolchain_boundary.implicit_import: Init for ordinary non-prelude Lean modules
official_toolchain_boundary.scope: Std/Init and their transitive official dependencies, elaborator/tactics, runtime, and Lake are pinned official toolchain trust boundaries, not included in the 423 project modules.

leanchecker.mode: fresh replay of requested modules and their imports; unsafe and partial declarations skipped

target_declarations.purpose: response front and carrier decode fields

scan.method: Independent Python standard-library text scan; nested Lean comments and quoted strings blanked with line preservation; broad hits reviewed and command-position checks applied. No Lean parser or kernel was run.

reviewed_false_positive.classification: Scheduler inductive constructors, patterns, and references; zero macro/elaborator commands.

limits: Source-token inspection is not a security proof or compiled axiom census.
Absence of explicit axiom/sorry does not establish absence of standard axioms such as propext, Quot.sound, or Classical.choice.
Ordinary tactic proofs, deriving, simp attributes, definitional computation, and official import initializers execute during elaboration.
Fresh compiled-environment type/axiom checking and kernel replay remain separate tasks.
This audit does not formalize or verify the new first-event composition.
Only the listed scan patterns were checked; zero matches are not a claim that all possible executable mechanisms were exhaustively ruled out.
